description: This source file is a shell script that defines functions and command-line processing logic to create UBI (Unsorted Block Images) layouts and generate configuration files for embedding data in NAND flash memory devices, specifically tailored for OpenWRT firmware images.

methods.name: ubivol
methods.description: Defines a UBI volume with specific parameters such as identifier, name, image, size, and flags.

methods.name: ubilayout
methods.description: Creates a layout of UBI volumes based on input parts, root filesystem, kernel image, and their types.

methods.name: set_ubinize_seq
methods.description: Sets a sequence parameter for ubinize command based on the SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH environment variable.
